title: Australian Appointment Setter – Solar, Batteries & Ducted Air Conditioning
description:
We are an established Western Australian-owned electrical company based in Perth. With over 12 years of industry experience and more than 400 five-star customer reviews, we directly supply and install solar panels, battery systems, ducted air conditioning and other electrical solutions.



We are seeking a highly experienced, professional appointment setter based in the Philippines to manage warm enquiries from Western Australian homeowners.



This is not a general virtual-assistant or entry-level call-centre position. We need someone who can communicate naturally with Australian customers, identify genuine opportunities and book high-quality appointments that attend.



The Role



You will be the first human point of contact for customers enquiring about solar, batteries or ducted air conditioning.



Your responsibilities will include:



Contacting new website, Google and social-media leads quickly.

Building rapport naturally with Australian homeowners.

Understanding the customer’s needs without sounding scripted.

Confirming homeownership, property location, product interest, timeframe and decision-making process.

Asking relevant qualification questions about electricity bills, existing solar systems, battery requirements or air-conditioning needs.

Explaining Solar 1 Nation Electricals and our consultation process professionally.

Booking qualified showroom or home consultations with our Perth sales consultants.

Confirming appointments and reducing cancellations and no-shows.

Following up customers who did not answer or were not ready initially.

Reactivating suitable older enquiries when requested.

Maintaining complete and accurate notes, tasks and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel.

Coordinating closely with our Perth sales team.



The goal is not simply to book as many appointments as possible. Success will be measured by the quality of the appointments, attendance rate, quotation opportunities and completed sales generated from your bookings.



Essential Experience



To be considered, you must have:



At least two years of appointment setting, telesales or lead-qualification experience.

Previous experience speaking with Australian customers.

Proven experience booking appointments for solar, batteries, energy, air conditioning, trades or other Australian home-improvement services.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong comprehension of Australian accents.

A confident, friendly and natural communication style.

Strong listening, qualification and objection-handling skills.

Experience managing warm inbound leads and structured follow-up sequences.

A reliable computer, professional headset, stable internet and quiet home-working environment.

Availability to work full-time during Perth/Philippines daytime business hours.



Direct experience with Australian residential solar, batteries or ducted air conditioning will be strongly preferred.



The Person We Are Looking For



The right person will:



Sound professional, natural and trustworthy on the telephone.

Listen carefully instead of mechanically reading a script.

Understand when to ask additional questions and when to move toward an appointment.

Handle objections such as “Just send me a price,” “I am only comparing companies,” or “I need to speak with my partner.”

Follow up consistently without pressuring or annoying customers.

Take ownership of every assigned lead.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and future follow-up tasks.

Care about customer experience and the quality of appointments booked.

Be dependable, organised and committed to a long-term position.

Please Do Not Apply If

You have no previous experience speaking with Australian customers.

Your background is limited to general virtual-assistant or administrative work.

You focus only on dial volume and cannot demonstrate appointment quality.

You regularly book customers who are unqualified or unaware of the appointment.

You are uncomfortable with follow-ups, objections or performance targets.

You cannot provide clear information about your previous results.

Performance Measures



Your performance will be evaluated using:



Speed of response to new leads.

Customer contact rate.

Number of genuinely qualified appointments booked.

Appointment attendance rate.

Accuracy and completeness of CRM notes.

Number of appointments progressing to quotations and sales.

Customer feedback and call quality.

Consistency, reliability and follow-up discipline.

What We Provide

Warm inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.

An established Australian brand with a Perth showroom and installation team.

Training on our products, pricing, qualification criteria and processes.

Approved call guides and objection-handling support.

GoHighLevel CRM access and structured workflows.

Competitive base salary based on verified experience.

Performance incentives linked to qualified appointments that attend and completed sales.

Stable, long-term employment.

Opportunities to progress into a Senior Appointment Setter, Sales Consultant or Team Leader position.

How to Apply



Please submit your updated CV and answer every question below:



How many years have you worked in appointment setting or telesales?

Which Australian companies or campaigns have you worked with?

Which products or services were you promoting?

Were the leads inbound, warm outbound or cold?

Approximately how many calls did you make each day?

How many qualified appointments did you book each week?

What was your average appointment attendance rate?

How did your previous employer define a qualified appointment?

Which Australian states did you contact?

Which CRM and calling systems have you used?

Can a previous manager verify your employment and performance?

What base salary and incentive structure are you expecting?



Please also include a 60–90 second voice or video introduction explaining:



Your experience speaking with Australian customers.

Your experience booking appointments.

How you would respond if a customer said: “I am only comparing prices. Just send me the cheapest option.”



Applications that do not include the requested answers and voice or video introduction will not be shortlisted.



If you are a high-quality appointment setter who understands Australian customers, values appointment quality and wants a stable long-term role with a growing Perth company, we would like to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — Northwear
description:
Northwear is a fast-growing Australian premium athleisure and fashion brand founded in 2019 by twin sisters Amy and Ellie. Our philosophy is simple: clothes that feel as good as they look. We're founder-led and online-only, with a loyal community (5.0? average across hundreds of reviews) and an engaged Instagram/TikTok audience. Our content is warm, polished, real — cool girl, not corporate. We never want it to feel like an ad.

The raw footage is already there — Amy is constantly filming. We need the person who can turn that into content people actually want to watch.

The Role

We're looking for a high-level Short-Form Video Editor to become the editor behind Northwear's TikTok, Reels, and Meta content. This isn't a traditional "add music and captions" role — we want someone with real taste and instinct, who can watch five minutes of raw phone footage and know exactly which 20 seconds will make someone stop scrolling. You'll work closely with our founder and have genuine creative input into how content is structured and presented.

What You'll Be Doing

• Edit raw phone footage into polished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, and Meta/Facebook

• Identify the strongest hooks, moments and stories within raw footage; edit for retention and pacing

• Add captions, on-screen text, trending audio and transitions

• Turn one raw footage session into multiple distinct pieces of content

• Make founder-led and talking-head content feel natural and social-first, not scripted

• Maintain a consistent Northwear visual identity; basic colour correction and audio cleanup

• Stay on top of current TikTok/Reels formats and trends

• Help manage a content/posting calendar so content goes out consistently

Must-Haves

• A genuinely strong portfolio of TikTok/Reels or short-form social content

• 2+ years of relevant short-form editing/content experience

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and social storytelling

• Fluent in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro, with strong captioning/text skills

• Reliable internet and hardware capable of handling video editing

• Able to work independently from a brief with minimal supervision, consistently meeting 24–48 hour turnarounds

• Full-time availability, working within a daily AEST-aligned workflow (flexible hours — not a rigid 9–5 — but reliably available for briefs and turnarounds)

Big Plus If You Have

• Experience with fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle or DTC/e-commerce brands

• Experience editing founder-led content or raw iPhone/phone footage

• A strong sense of TikTok trends before they go mainstream

• Basic motion graphics or Canva skills

• Experience using performance data to improve content

What You Get

• PHP 50,000–75,000/month based on experience — top end available for editors who demonstrate strong retention-focused thinking

• Stable, ongoing full-time work with a growing Australian brand

• Direct access to a founder-led creative team and genuine creative input — this is not a content mill

• Fast decision-making, and room to grow into a bigger content/creative role as Northwear scales

How to Apply

Applications that skip the steps below won't be considered — we're deliberately filtering for people who actually read the brief.

• Start your application with: NORTHWEAR HOOK — this must be the first thing in your application

• Send your 3 best short-form videos (TikTok/Reels), ideally showing raw footage ? final edit, with one sentence per video on why it worked

• In 2–3 sentences: what's one thing you'd change about Northwear's current TikTok or Instagram content, just from looking at our page?

• Shortlisted applicants get a short piece of raw Northwear footage and turn it into a short-form video as a paid test edit — $30 AUD, paid regardless of outcome, within 48 hours of submission



Start your application with: NORTHWEAR HOOK

title: Instagram Lead Generation & Appointment Setter – Online Fitness Coaching
description:
Hey! I’m looking for someone who can help me aggressively generate high-quality leads for my online fitness coaching business through Instagram.



This is more than just responding to DMs. I’m looking for someone who can actively hunt for potential clients every day and consistently build a pipeline of prospects. 



Your responsibilities would include:

• Engaging with every new follower I receive and starting conversations with them when appropriate. ( I have saved replies you can easily click on as well for the initial message)



• Scrubbing Instagram for high-intent prospects — for example, finding people commenting things like “COACH,” “INFO,” “HOW,” etc. under posts from larger fitness/bodybuilding/fitness coaching accounts, since these people are actively showing interest in coaching.



• Cold outreach at high volume — sending as many quality DMs as Instagram reasonably allows each day while still making the messages personalized enough to actually start conversations.



• Finding potential clients through Instagram search, hashtags, followers of relevant fitness accounts, engagement on fitness content, and similar sources.



• Following high-quality potential leads to get on their radar and engaging with their content where appropriate.



• Unfollowing low-quality/unresponsive prospects after an appropriate period so the account stays organized and the following list doesn’t become cluttered.



• Tracking conversations and prospects so we know who has been contacted, who responded, who is interested, who needs follow-up, and who is no longer a prospect.



• Following up consistently with people who showed interest but didn’t book or move forward.



• Ultimately, the goal is to identify people who are likely to need online coaching, start conversations with them, qualify them, and get qualified prospects onto calls with me.



I’m looking for someone who is very proactive. I don't want someone who sits around waiting for followers or inbound messages. I want someone who is constantly looking for new opportunities and finding people who could realistically become coaching clients while I handle pushing out quality content.



I’m especially interested in someone who can work consistently every day, handle high DM volume, stay organized, and focus on quality prospects rather than just sending random messages. 



Additional Lead Generation Experience (Bonus):

While Instagram will be the primary focus, having experience with other platforms, software, or lead-generation methods is a major plus. For example, if you know how to find qualified prospects through LinkedIn,
, TikTok, Reddit, or other platforms and successfully direct them to my Instagram or coaching website, that would be extremely valuable.



If you have experience using AI tools, automations, or other software to find, research, qualify, or generate high-quality leads, that is an even bigger plus. I’m especially interested in someone who can leverage AI to make the lead-generation process more efficient and consistently bring in more qualified prospects.



I’m looking for someone who can think outside the box and continuously find new ways to generate qualified leads, rather than being limited to one platform or method. The more value and qualified leads you’re able to bring to the business, the more your pay will increase and your performance will be rewarded.



Please tell me, how many hours per day you can work, and roughly how many qualified prospects you believe you can find/contact per week.

title: SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR for TikTok Shop
description:
FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — TikTok Shop

High Volume | 10+ Videos/Day | Long-Term Position

We are looking for an EXPERIENCED short-form video editor to join our team FULL-TIME.

This is NOT an entry-level editing position.

We produce a high volume of TikTok Shop content and need an editor who is FAST, creative, reliable, and already understands how modern TikTok/Reels/Shorts content should be edited.

If you're still learning how to edit short-form content, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING

Our raw videos are typically 3–8 minutes long.

You will turn that footage into polished, engaging TikTok Shop videos, generally around 30–90 seconds depending on the content.

We will provide:

✓ Raw talking-head/product footage 

✓ Product B-roll 

✓ Overlays 

✓ Product images/assets when needed 

✓ Examples/reference videos when appropriate

You will NOT normally need to spend hours searching the internet for B-roll.

Your job is to take the assets we provide and turn them into fast-paced, high-retention TikTok Shop videos.



EXPECTED OUTPUT

Our target is approximately:

8–10+ FINISHED SHORT-FORM VIDEOS PER DAY

Some edits will be extremely simple.

Others will require more editing, B-roll, captions, overlays, graphics, sound effects, punch-ins, etc.

We understand that not every video requires the same amount of work.

However, SPEED MATTERS A LOT in this position.

We are NOT looking for someone who takes 3–4 hours to edit one 45-second TikTok.

We need an editor who understands how to produce QUALITY AT VOLUME.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW HOW TO:

✓ Identify the strongest hook

✓ Cut unnecessary dialogue and dead space

✓ Tighten a 3–8 minute raw recording into a strong short-form video

✓ Create fast, natural pacing

✓ Add clean captions

✓ Use punch-ins / zooms appropriately

✓ Add B-roll and overlays at the right moments

✓ Add music and sound effects when appropriate

✓ Use pattern interrupts without OVER-editing

✓ Keep the viewer visually engaged

✓ Understand TikTok/Reels/Shorts pacing

✓ Make videos feel NATIVE to TikTok instead of looking like corporate advertisements

Experience editing TikTok Shop, UGC, e-commerce or direct-response content is HIGHLY preferred.



EDITING SOFTWARE

We DON'T CARE what editing software you use.

Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, etc. are all acceptable.

We care about the RESULT.

If your videos are great and you can produce them quickly, use whatever makes you fastest.



WHO WE WANT

We are looking for someone who:

✓ Is an experienced SHORT-FORM editor

✓ Is FAST

✓ Has strong creative instincts

✓ Understands spoken English extremely well

✓ Can determine what should be CUT from a video

✓ Can follow instructions

✓ Can recreate an editing style from a reference

✓ Pays attention to details

✓ Communicates well

✓ Meets deadlines

✓ Doesn't disappear

✓ Doesn't need to be constantly reminded about assignments

✓ Handles feedback professionally

✓ Wants consistent, long-term work

Our goal is to find someone who eventually knows our editing style so well that we can send you footage and trust you to handle the rest.



HOW TO APPLY

We receive A LOT of applications.

If you don't follow these instructions, your application will automatically be skipped.

Start your application with:

"I'M YOUR SHORTS EDITOR"

Then answer ALL 7 questions:

1. How many 30–90 second videos can you REALISTICALLY edit during an 8-hour workday if you're given 3–8 minutes of raw footage plus the B-roll/assets?

2. What editing software do you use?

3. How many years have you been professionally editing short-form videos?

4. Have you edited TikTok Shop, UGC, e-commerce or direct-response videos before? Briefly explain.

5. What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a FULL-TIME position?

6. What computer do you edit on? Please include RAM and basic specs.

7. Are you currently working for any other clients/employers? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

Send us links to your:

3 BEST SHORT-FORM VIDEOS

NOT 20.

NOT your entire Google Drive.

NOT a giant portfolio and tell us to look through it.

Pick your THREE BEST.

We specifically want to see examples demonstrating:

• Talking-head editing • TikTok/Reels/Shorts pacing • UGC/e-commerce/TikTok Shop content • Captions and visual storytelling • Strong pacing and retention

If possible, include at least one example where you personally took longer raw footage and turned it into the final short-form video.

We're looking for an EDITOR.

Someone who understands what to cut, what to keep, how to maintain attention, and how to make short-form content perform.

If that's you, we'd love to see your work.

title: GoHighLevel Automation Virtual Assistant — API, Integrations, Custom Builds (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
Read this entire post before you apply. There are specific instructions inside it. If you miss any of them, I will not read your application. That is deliberate — this job is largely about following technical specifications exactly.



WHO I AM

I run Grow With AI, a small US automation agency. We build AI receptionists, lead systems, and custom CRM work for small businesses in trades, legal, and services. I am the founder. Right now it is mostly me. I am hiring the person who becomes the technical half of this company.



WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

This is not a GoHighLevel VA job. This is not "build me a funnel." You will:



- Connect GoHighLevel to anything — other CRMs, POS systems, databases, custom software — in both directions

- Work directly with the GHL v2 API, OAuth, webhooks, and Private Integration tokens

- Build custom dashboards and reporting that GHL cannot do natively

- Design and run databases (Supabase or similar)

- Build small custom apps and internal tools

- Own integrations end to end, including when they break



TOOLS YOU GET

You will have access to Claude Cowork and our AI tooling. I have no problem with you using AI to do the work — I use it constantly. What I care about is whether you can direct it, catch it when it is wrong, and fix what it breaks. If AI is doing the thinking for you instead of the typing, you will not get through my screening.



THE SCHEDULE — READ THIS TWICE

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time. In the Philippines that is a graveyard shift. Do not apply unless you are certain you can hold that schedule long term. I would rather you tell me no today than quit in month two.



PAY, HONESTLY

Starting: $500 USD per month, full-time, plus performance bonuses.



I know that is under market for this skill set, so here is the real deal.



At six months, if the work has been what I need, the base moves to $900-$1,000. That review is a commitment, not a maybe.



At twelve months, if you have stayed with me through the build and the company is where I expect it to be, you are looking at roughly three times what you started on — and it keeps climbing from there. I am not going to pretend that number is guaranteed, because it depends on us growing. What I will tell you is that it is the trajectory I am building toward, and the person in this seat is the person who gets carried by it.



I am early, and I am telling you exactly where I stand. If you need $1,200 today, we are not a fit and I respect that.



SUBJECT LINE

The subject line of your application must be exactly:



GHL-BUILDER-2026 - FLAMINGO - [your first name]



Yes, flamingo. Type it exactly. Applications with any other subject line are deleted unread.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR

Reliability and trustworthiness above everything else. You will have access to client systems and client data. I need someone who says what they will do, does it, and tells me early when something is going wrong. I am not looking for someone who goes quiet for three days and then sends an excuse.



DO NOT SEND FILES

Do not attach a resume, CV, or portfolio document. Anyone who attaches a file is removed immediately. Instead, paste five bullet points into the body of your message describing the five most technical things you have personally built.



HOW TO APPLY

Begin your message with the single word: Compass



Then answer these five questions, numbered, in this exact order:



1. Describe a system you personally connected to GoHighLevel. What was on the other end, which direction did data flow, and what broke?

2. You are syncing contacts two ways between GHL and another CRM. Both fire a webhook on update. How do you stop the infinite loop?

3. A client wants reporting GHL cannot do natively. Describe how you would build them a custom dashboard, including where the data lives.

4. Tell me about a time AI gave you a confidently wrong answer, and how you caught it.

5. When it is 9:00 AM in Chicago, what time and what date is it where you are?



Your entire application must be under 250 words, not counting the five bullets. I am testing whether you can be brief and precise.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If you pass this stage: a short screen-recorded technical exercise, then a paid trial project ($25 USD, roughly 3 hours, paid whether or not you advance), then a live interview at 9:00 AM Central. I will tell you either way. I will not waste your time.

title: VIDEO EDITOR WANTED, LONG-TERM, $500/MONTH
description:
We run a large short-form content operation, our clips pull millions of views across a big network of accounts, and we're adding editors to the team. Long-term position with steady work every single week.



The work: Editing recorded OmeTV sessions into short viral clips. You watch the footage, find the moments worth clipping, and cut them into clean vertical clips with sound effects, captions and good pacing. You're not hunting for perfect moments, normal ones work fine, we just skip the boring small talk. What matters is that a stranger watching can follow what's going on. We provide all the footage, there's always more than you can finish.



The pay, two options, you choose:



1. Standard. Steady hours, fixed pay. You work the set schedule, hit the daily numbers, and get the same $500 every month. Nothing to calculate and no surprises. If the footage is thin one day you still get paid the same.



2. Per clip. You get paid for every clip you deliver. Hit the same daily numbers and you land on the same $500, but there's no ceiling on it. An extra hour or two a day puts you around $600, and the ones who really push go past that. Plus $10 on top for every clip that passes 1M views.



Both are paid on the 1st and 15th, always on time. No hourly rate and no time tracker either way.



Requirements: Full-time, around 8 hours a day, 6 days a week. Fast stable internet and a PC that handles editing smoothly. Short-form editing experience, CapCut is enough.



Every clip goes through review and only approved clips are paid, we approve everything as long as the quality is there. We choose few people and keep the ones who deliver.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – Fashion/Lifestyle TikTok & Reels
description:
## About Us



The Shortlist is a growing fashion-tech app that helps women better understand their personal style, make smarter wardrobe decisions, and get more out of the clothes they already own.



We're building our social presence primarily through TikTok and Instagram Reels, with founder-led content around personal style, closets, outfit decisions, shopping, and the process of building The Shortlist.



We're looking for a talented **short-form video editor** to help turn our raw footage into polished, engaging content that feels elevated while still feeling natural and native to social media.



## What You'll Edit



Approximately **20 short-form videos per month**, primarily 15–60 seconds each.



Content will include:



* Founder talking-to-camera videos

* GRWM and outfit content

* Closet and styling B-roll

* Voiceover videos

* App demonstrations and screen recordings

* Founder/building-a-business content



We will provide the raw footage along with the concept, hook, key message, and any specific direction needed.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone with a strong visual eye who understands **fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or premium consumer brands**.



Your edits should feel polished and intentional without looking overly produced.



Think:



* Strong opening hooks

* Excellent pacing and clean cuts

* Tasteful, modern captions and typography

* Strategic use of B-roll

* Clean audio and audio enhancement

* Basic color/exposure correction

* Music and subtle sound design when appropriate

* Thoughtful visual changes that improve retention

* A consistent visual identity across our content



We **do not** want overly aggressive editing, constant zooms, excessive effects, giant captions, or a generic "viral video" aesthetic.



The goal is **elevated, stylish, conversational and native to TikTok/Reels.**



## Who You Are



You:



* Have experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts

* Have a portfolio of short-form work

* Understand hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Have strong aesthetic judgment

* Can work independently once you understand our style

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Ideally have experience with fashion, beauty, lifestyle, DTC brands, creators, or female founders



You can use CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or another professional editing platform. We care much more about the finished product than which software you use.



## Workflow



Our goal is to create a simple ongoing system:



**We provide:** raw footage + concept + hook + creative direction



**You provide:** polished, ready-to-post TikTok/Reel



As we work together, we'd like to develop several repeatable editing styles/templates so that less direction is required for each video.



## Schedule & Compensation



This is an **ongoing part-time freelance position**.



Expected volume: approximately **20 videos/month**



Budget: **$400–$500 USD/month**, depending on experience, quality, and final scope.



We're looking for someone interested in developing a long-term relationship with the brand as we grow.



## Paid Editing Trial



Finalists will be invited to complete a **paid editing trial** using real raw footage from The Shortlist.



We will provide the same footage and creative direction to each finalist. This is paid work — we do not expect applicants to create free sample edits.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Links to the **3 short-form videos you've edited that best represent the aesthetic you would bring to a women's fashion/lifestyle brand.**

3. Your role in creating those videos.

4. The editing software you primarily use.

5. Your typical turnaround time for a short-form video.

6. Your expected monthly rate for approximately 20 videos.



**Please do not send a large general portfolio. We specifically want to see the three examples you believe are most relevant to this brand and editing style.**
